notes.title: New Feature: Map Exploration
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/357707fa519df9ce1bd7687fc32bbd88d4865cf4.png[/img]

Good morning, fateful friends! We have a fun update for you today~

While you wait for the next content drop we have cooking — i.e., an 11k-word [b]side story[/b] coming out on June 21 (for free!) — we decided to release our [b]Map Exploration[/b] feature for you to try out!

After you click on the [b]World Map[/b] button in our main menu, you will be taken to a map of Tír na nÓg. Originally, this was all the World Map did, but now you will have the ability to click on various landmarks and explore the world yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/108a48dcca7a37098f264f67716d5ad492326c5f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/0ccfaaa8a16244a0afaeb42c23a3dd3f38e627d8.png[/img]

Navigate between environments with the arrows, and as you poke around, you'll likely run into some familiar faces! If you click on them, they'll interact with you, and we plan on adding more short scenes/interactions as time goes on. We'll add more spots to visit as well! Along with a healthy handful of [i]horsing around[/i], if you catch my meaning.

That's all for now! We hope you enjoy! And don't worry: We're hard at work getting Maeve and Shae's 2nd halves ready to play. We'll have more information on their release dates when the side story comes out!

Slán go foill!

- Clotho

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch: Experimental Save System, Hoverable-Definitions, and more
notes.notes:
Good evening, fateful friends!

We're here with a quality-of-life patch for some new, highly requested features! Here's the gist:

[list]
[*] [b]Experimental Saving:[/b] If you go into settings, you can now turn on a saving feature that will allow you to save your choices in each book. This feature is still experimental, which means we're still working out how best to optimize it. Nevertheless: Once this feature is enabled, a gear icon will appear in the book menus for Volumes 1-7. Clicking this will take you to a menu that allows you to save your current progress, load an old save, delete saves, etc. Here's a visual guide:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/3886b6741f43e3fd61b2f7fd08ee2459d6e15f83.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Quick Definitions:[/b] When your mouse hovers over glossary entries (i.e. the green text), a quick definition or translation of the entry will pop up at the top of the screen. You'll still need to click the entry to access the audio translation, but if you just need a definition-reminder, this should reduce the amount of time you're clicking between pages.
[*] [b]Feedback Form:[/b] We've added a link in our settings menu to a form for providing direct feedback!  While we also have a feedback channel in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rcQbKT3kVV]Discord server[/url], we figured this would be a good option for players who aren't interested or able to join Discord. You can also access the form [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdg8Q-X75g8m5sV13qIM7ClKhkGFiP0C-NoZBwRhcDlsay1bA/formResponse]here[/url]. We're open to any and all feedback (especially for the new features mentioned here), but obviously more complicated feedback will take longer to implement, if we're able to do so. Let us know if you spot any typos or bugs as well!
[*] [b]Other fixes:[/b] Some typos, credit tweaks, and the map is now navigated by clicking and dragging.
[/list]

That's all for now! Slán go foill!

- Clotho

notes.title: Shae's Mam, UI Updates, Route Release Order
notes.notes:
Good evening, fateful friends!

Firstly, we're glad to see that everyone seems to be enjoying the update so far! We've personally had a delightful time seeing everyone's reactions over on our Discord server, especially regarding... Well, if you know, you know. Anyway! This is just a small announcement to notify you of an update for [i]The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)[/i], which current players should already have access to, and to reiterate some earlier news we announced on social media regarding the route release order.

[h2]Game Updates[/h2]

Shae’s route has a new sprite! Specifically, a sprite for Shae’s Mam – Sláine. We originally used one of our generic sprites for this character when we launched, because the beauty before us wasn’t ready at the time, but now she’s here! Hurray! Get a load of that smile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/f339df384b9193ba4e7d624a0650512c4a7696bb.png[/img]

[h2]UI Updates[/h2]

We’ve added some new buttons to the main menu that we think will be useful going forward. First, in the top right, you’ll see a bell icon. This is what we’re going to use for in-game notifications, which will usually entail information about new updates, future releases, major news, etc. Essentially, it will help you stay informed about the game’s current status. When you notice a little red dot on the bell, that means there’s something new to look at!

The other icons link back to our most-used social media pages, Discord server, and Patreon page, in case you’d like to follow us elsewhere, join the official NDM fan space, or throw a little extra support our way. Our Patreon consists mostly of mirrors of our Kickstarter updates, though -- so if you're one of our Kickstarter backers, there's nothing new for you on that platform at the moment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/aa738c2ec85a1b8571face2f8941fc7dd51947a0.png[/img]

[h2]Route Release Order[/h2]

Lastly, while we're here, we wanted to take a moment to reiterate some statements we've made on our social media regarding [i]The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)[/i]'s official route order, in case you haven't seen it yet:

Some folks have asked us, both now and in the weeks leading up to Shae and Maeve's routes, what the overall route update order will be for the rest of NDM.  Initially, we'd planned to keep the route order a semi-secret in order to hype up the reveal for the next batch of characters, but after some thought/observation, the Moirai Myths team now thinks that revealing the order, and further explaining the order, would be more holistically useful to our players.

First things first: We are most likely always going to do route updates in two half-batches, instead of releasing the full route for one character at once. Two halves of two routes is roughly equivalent to one full route, so we could release each route one at a time, but this decreases the odds of us having an update that interests you if you're only presently interested in a few members of the cast. With this in mind, we've purposefully plotted out the routes so that the midway point for all routes will end on a cliffhanger or point of intrigue to encourage discussion/speculation regarding "what could come next," etc. If you've played Shae and Maeve's routes thus far, you'll know exactly what we mean by that. 😄

On that note: Why are Shae and Maeve's routes first? A small part of it is logistical. While they're not our most popular characters overall, most people like Shae and Maeve well enough coming out of the demo (Vol. 1), which gives them a decently broad appeal-potentiality. Preliminary data of ours also suggests that the average person's interest in these characters increases following the update. *wink* However, the second and larger reason is because of NDM's overarching story. While each route, as with other dating sims, explores the specific character arcs and personal struggles of their namesakes, these things are not the sole focus of the routes. NDM's story begins in a cold war scenario that could very well turn into a hot war scenario under the wrong set of circumstances. These plot points are persistent across the game, but certain elements are looked at more closely in some routes than in others.

Shae and Maeve basically serve as the introductory characters for our world beyond Vol. 1. Their routes explain essential concepts, such as the class dynamics of Tír na nÓg, the nature of the War of the Courts, etc., and they get some pretty big backstory questions answered and out of the way early on. This allows future routes to focus on other, similarly critical subjects, unimpeded by the need to go over previously-revealed information from the other routes in the same amount of detail. To that end, since major reveals in Shae and Maeve's routes may be comparatively understated in the next batch of routes, this begs the question... 

[h3]✨ Is there an official recommended reading order? ✨[/h3]

Yes. And some of our players have already guessed it: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/fe40649c763bfa30cce320ebe6b9d2898d3e84e1.png[/img]

Book of the Traveller (Vol. 1) is the "inciting incident" content for the game and must be read first. After that, you should play Shae's route (Book of the Soldier, Vol. 2), then Maeve's route (Book of the Warrior, Vol. 3). This means, according to the numbering: The next route batch will be Flannán and Aífe. Following them, Robin and Keagan.

We understand that in a lot of visual novels, routes can be read in any order without much impact to the story or experience. This is not so much the case with [i]The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)[/i], for the reasons we have previously explained. While we would not say the game would necessarily be ruined if players chose to, say, start with Keagan's route and work their way backwards, it would nevertheless be a less satisfying experience because you won't be getting the gradual build up of certain concepts and plot points in the prior volumes. In a sense, it would be somewhat similar to reading an actual book series out of order: You could probably read The Two Towers ahead of The Fellowship of the Ring and still have an enjoyable time, but you might find yourself asking, "Hm, why are they sending Hobbits on an important task like this? Sort of odd that an elf or human wasn't given this duty instead."

We hope this is clarifying as to our artistic intent and general plans, and remember: Your favourite characters will appear in major ways across multiple routes, and we will be releasing side story DLCs featuring the other characters in between updates. 😊

Slán go foill! (Bye for now!) And thank you for all of your support so far!

-The Moirai Myths Team

notes.title: November 1, 2024: Shae & Maeve's Routes (Part 1)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/bf018eaf9c8b9db684d78938bb2ace0dafa3b0d5.png[/img]

Good morning, fateful friends!

If you haven't yet heard from our other social media accounts, the first full-game update will soon be upon us: As of November 1, 2024, we will be releasing part one of Shae and Maeve's routes, respectively called the Book of the Soldier and the Book of the Warrior. Here's what to expect if you choose to purchase it:

[list]
[*] The first five chapters of Shae and Maeve's routes — totaling 100k words, individually 50k words (for comparison, the demo is 37k!)
[*] 175 choices, impacting both your relationship with Shae/Maeve and the projected ending (NDM can be played romantically or platonically, and each route will have good/bad endings!)
[*] Multiple scene variations depending on your current relationship/ending paths
[*] Additional sprites and outfits for both current and new characters (every member of the cast makes an appearance in this update!)
[*] Several new background locations to explore
[*] Four stunning CGs by our guest artists
[*] Twenty-five new voice lines for Shae and Maeve, and ten new voice lines for the rest of the main cast
[*] Drama! Danger! Mystery! Betrayal?! Love...? 
[/list]

[h2]Pricing & Reasoning[/h2]

On Nov. 1, the price of NDM will be $14.99 USD. [b]Once paid for, all subsequent updates will be free, excluding side story DLCs.[/b] Note that this price will increase with each new update, however, so if you decide to wait until your preferred route(s) are out, it will be more expensive. 

The gist of our price reasoning is as follows: As stipulated in our January 2023 Kickstarter, NDM is a serialized project. If it wasn't, the game wouldn't be ready to play until the late 2020s (just half of one route is longer than the original demo, after all) and we want you all to be able to experience the story as soon as possible! However, we recognize some folks are wary about buying unfinished games, which is why we decided:

[olist]
[*] The earlier the game is bought, the less it costs. This is our thank-you for supporting us at this stage of development. 
[*] We won't micro-transaction the main game content, i.e. the routes. You pay once, and the price reflects the amount of content currently available.
[/olist]

Since you're buying the game on Steam, these updates will happen automatically.

[h2]Mechanical Updates[/h2]

Along with the routes, there are two mechanical updates coming to the paid version of [i]The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)[/i] that we wanted to talk about briefly. The first update concerns the MC/Daonna sprites: Along with the recent additional sprites we provided, we've introduced a 4th MC/Daonna option which will allow the sprite to appear in-game as a blank silhouette or a customizable sprite that players can manually add-in via the game files. Daonna's clothes will still be visible for story reasons, but the arm/face/neck/etc. will appear "blank" unless overridden by custom files. (Instructions will be provided in the same folder.) This option exists for players who don't like the "canon" options. Beyond this point, we are unlikely to include full customization due to the cost, but we hope our artistically-inclined players will have fun inserting their own designs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/84648e0630941d132f61456ced8eaa2c4f0d5c67.png[/img]

The second update concerns saving and replaying: As demonstrated in this short sneak peek of Shae's route, we now have an instant-save feature in the individual chapters. This will allow you to manually save while in a chapter, and if you have to exit the game mid-chapter, your spot will be "bookmarked" automatically. All you need to do to reload is click on the chapter and press "load bookmark" in the top right.

[previewyoutube=HiuklI8gnoA;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/704a9680e1da13c46737f494ba4eb320cf692308.png[/img]

That said, we do not currently have multiple save files, meaning the decisions you make in previous chapters are carried over to subsequent chapters/affect future scenes and the ending(s) — when we get there. However, if you would like to replay individual chapters without your choices saving/carrying over, you can turn on "replay mode". This means that all of your choices will be contained to the chapter you're currently playing, and not saved after it concludes. Feel free to use this mode to experiment with choice selection!

[h2]The Demo[/h2]

As we conclude this announcement, we wanted to remind everyone that the demo is most likely not going to be updated again, with the last update being on Sept. 4, 2024. It will remain available for new players to gauge whether they're interested in the paid version of the game, but any new general features, mechanics, or slight updates made to the demo contents (i.e. Volume 1)  are going to be in the paid game only. Ultimately, this is because keeping the demo up-to-date alongside the paid game would be a bit of a hassle. :P

Anyway, that's all for now! Slán go foill!! See you November 1!!!

- Clotho

notes.title: Demo Update: New MC/Daonna Sprites!
notes.notes:
Good morning, fateful friends!

We have an exciting update for The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe) today! Specifically, the demo now officially boasts three new sprites for MC and Daonna!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/88fb254ff883b41001deded56681ea2938eec599.gif[/img]

If you remember from our Kickstarter, one of our stretch goals was the ability to fully customize the appearance of MC and their mysterious doppelganger, Daonna. Sadly, we weren't able to reach this goal at the time - which meant that for the foreseeable future, MC and Daonna would be functionally represented by a single sprite. This was obviously not ideal, since this limits players to a single skin tone, hair colour, eye colour, etc., so after our Kickstarter ended we decided to go back to the drawing board and come up with a middle ground solution that was more realistic/feasible for us. Hence: Daonna now has three distinct designs, which players can use as a basis for their MCs if they want to. (Examples: Maybe your MC styles their hair differently, or never goes without rouge!) Ultimately though, if you still prefer your own headcanon to our sprites, feel free to consider them simply interpretations of MC/Daonna's many possible appearances! Mythology is often full of contradictions, after all ;)

In addition to MC/Daonna, there are a few other new things in this version of the demo:

[list]
[*] Bug fixes (missing audio for Milesian, missing entry for Finn, some typos, missing credit names)
[*] A new, fabulous sprite for the lady shopkeeper (with another for the shopkeeper man on the way!)
[*] A new sprite for Maeve's crows
[*] A new animation for Maeve's crows
[*] Minor UI updates
[/list]

That's all for now! Slán go foill!

- Clotho

notes.title: Revised Demo: Now Out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/39d5bc4206aba4e2046bd8ca05fb7706dd4f7458.png[/img]

Dia daoibh, fateful friends!

The revised demo for The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe) is officially here! Whether you're an old or new player, we believe giving this new demo a try is 100% worth it: The UI has been majorly re-worked, all of the backgrounds have been updated, we have proper NPC sprites now, tons of new voice acting, and more! I mean, just take a look at the before/after of our main menu...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/41f0874edb716b31dec519ec3a78761beb61838d.png[/img]

Isn't it gorgeous? And SO much less cluttered?! Look here! You can even immediately tell how to access the demo's individual chapters now!! Much better than randomly discovering the body text is clickable... 😅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/011de11f898a3051af72b1abd046f58008ef282e.png[/img]

notes.title: KICKSTARTER: 100% FUNDED! 11 Days to Reach Stretch Goals!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/947e5c429bfa9ec22e238cda9fb6ca2a590cfde1.png[/img]

[h3][b]IT'S OFFICIAL, FATEFUL FRIENDS![/b][/h3]

As of midday yesterday, thanks to our 550 backers, we have reached our Kickstarter's main fundraising goal! [i]The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)[/i] has been fully funded, and we have 11 days to go to reach our stretch goals! Which are:

[list]
[*] [b]SIDE STORIES[/b] (*30K USD / 40K CAD): At this stretch goal, we'll release short stories in-between our route releases that follow the other characters, so that there will always be a little content for everyone! The side stories will consist of backstory content, interpersonal stories between the love interests, romantic/platonic content with the MC, and anything else we might want to share that won't be fully fleshed out in the routes themselves!
[*] [b]CUSTOM MCs[/b] (*35K USD / 47K CAD): MC will receive a sprite that players will be allowed to customize, influencing eye colour, hair colour, skin tone, facial features, and hairstyle. This will also impact Daonna's sprite, as well as both of their CGs, given MC and Daonna are identical.
[*] [b]EXPANDED VOICE ACTING[/b] (*40K USD / 53K CAD): If you enjoyed our voice acting samples, this stretch goal will allow us to increase our voice acting budget from limited to partial! That means there will be more fully voiced scenes for important narrative moments throughout our game!
[*] [b]MORE SPRITE OUTFITS[/b] (*50K USD / 67k CAD): Exactly what it sounds like. We'll give all the ROs and select side characters alternative sprite outfits, or variations on their existing outfits.
[*] [b]MINI GAMES[/b] (*60K USD / 80K CAD): Mini Games will allow players to explore the world of NDM by simulating  Daonna's daily druidic duties. This will in turn give your MC unique  "traits" that open up new pathways in the routes. Example: A high  "fairyfolk handling" skill will make your MC more personable to the aes sídhe in the routes.
[*] [b]SWITCH PORT[/b] (*70K USD / 94K CAD): Exactly what it sounds like. When our game is 100% complete, we will work to port the full game to the Switch! (Routes will be available for PC/Mac before this, and all of our supporters at the Soldier's Essentials tier and higher will receive a copy of the game for the Switch, as well as a PC/Mac copy, if this goal is reached.) 
[/list]

*Noteworthy: All our Kickstarter graphics were created and listed in USD for the convenience of our audience, which we determined to be primarily American. However, over the course of our campaign (particularly as we were unlocking the flirty sprites) we realized that the exchange rate was fluctuating near daily between USD and CAD, and to a significant degree, so it became difficult to determine when our goals were being reached. (Incidentally, this is also why our full campaign funding is not exactly 25K USD, as listed in our graphic. We have the funding we need, it's just not worth 25K USD anymore. Thanks, Canada.) So, because of this constant fluctuation, we will consider a stretch goal reached if we hit either the USD or CAD amount. Ergo, if we hit 40K CAD in three days, but that 40K CAD is not quite worth 30K USD, we will have still reached that goal regardless.

[h3]Thank you all once again from the bottom of our hearts. Can you help us reach some of our stretch goals before the campaign period ends? Either way, we're so excited to share our full project with you all![/h3]

notes.title: KICKSTARTER: NOW OUT!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/3772a99e5c4531fc9f360229580f8cb49eec8d51.png[/img]

[b][h1]The Good People: Na Daoine Maithe is officially live on Kickstarter![/h1][/b]

Happy New Year, Fateful Friends! We bring momentous tidings: Our Kickstarter campaign is now live! If you enjoyed playing our demo and want to see our full game get made, we would HIGHLY encourage you to check out our Kickstarter and consider donating and/or sharing us with others! If we get funded, here's what you can expect to see from our full game:

[list][*] [b]Six Character Routes[/b]: There will be six character routes in total, each one exploring the individual stories of our diverse cast of Love Interests (LIs)! There are two men, two women, and two non-binary folk to choose from. Half of our cast is aspec, as well!
[*] [b]Secret Story Route[/b]: If you play through all six character routes, you'll unlock the secret story route! It's designed to tie up the broader narrative aspects of the game, and you can choose which character route is "canon" to your play through!
[*] [b]Flexible MC[/b]: Choose your preferred name and pronouns (including neo pronouns) and romance whomever you please! (We even have a stretch goal to customize MC's sprite appearance, too!)
[*] [b]Platonic Options[/b]: Not into romance, or don't want to romance them all? Not to worry! All routes can be played platonically.
[*] [b]Multiple Endings[/b]: Each route has two endings based on the health of your relationship with the LI, regardless of whether it's romantic or platonic.
[*] [b]English-Gaeilge Lexicon[/b]: Our game features translatable Gaeilge (Irish) words and phrases, and in the full game, translations will be voiced for ease of pronunciation!
[*] [b]Voice Acting[/b]: The main cast will have limited voice acting in the full game. Check our Kickstarter page periodically for voice actor reveals and samples!
[*] [b]Other Features (Stretch Goals)[/b]: Side stories in-between route releases, MC customization, expanded voice acting, more sprite outfits, mini games, and a Switch port. [/list]

Our Kickstarter page contains a ton more detail - including a breakdown of the rewards you could receive for donating to us, and a timeline for the full game's release - so be sure to click the link below!

Howdy, Fateful Friends! Have you enjoyed the demo for The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe)? If so, we'd like to hear from you! More specifically, we want to know what you'd like to see out of our future Kickstarter!

Google Form Link: [url=https://t.co/WkVCbp0u96]https://t.co/WkVCbp0u96[/url]

By answering this short and anonymous feedback form, you will help us determine what routes are most "in demand" (which will help us figure out the release order), and it will give us an idea of what you all will want to see in the full game!

Want voice acting? Original music? Platonic routes? Side stories? Mini games? Custom MCs? Now's your chance to let us know! We can't guarantee that everything in this form will become a Kickstarter goal, so if you *really* want it, it's important that we know now. Likewise, you'll also be able to tell us what sorts of things you'll be interested in as tier rewards, too!

With all that in mind, we do ask that only folks who have played the demo answer this survey, so if you haven't had a chance yet, please do!

notes.title: THE GOOD PEOPLE (NA DAOINE MAITHE) DEMO IS OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42612657/d3280c7e74a2cc5f2d399bef02700aa8f064c827.png[/img]

The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe) is a lore-rich and choice-driven romantic visual novel inspired by Irish mythology. Play as an Irish tenant farmer from the mid-19th century, whose path becomes inexplicably entwined with fairy affairs after getting robbed by the roadside and lured into the mythic and war-torn world of Tír na nÓg: A once unified land, now divided into the Seelie and Unseelie Courts. Will you escape with your stolen belongings? Or does fate have something else in mind?

[b]FEATURES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Approx. 3 hours of FREE game play 🎊
[*] Six Romance Options (two men, two women, & two nb folk) 🌈
[*] A gender-flexible MC  ⚧️
[*] Dynamic choices 🔀
[*] Secrets 🤫
[/list]
[b]DOWNLOAD US ON STEAM![/b]
